instruction: Speak in German. Please say this at a brisk, energetic tempo.
text: Der Hauptunterschied zwischen den beiden Modellen liegt in der Akkukapazität und der Bildschirmgröße.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is delivered at a clearly brisk and energetic tempo, successfully meeting the fast speed requirement.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speaker articulates the sentence rapidly, maintaining a noticeably fast and energetic pace throughout.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is fluent, smooth, and free of synthetic artifacts, sounding very natural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The energetic delivery matches the brisk instruction well, showing appropriate expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in German. Deliver this line at a very fast pace, almost breathlessly.
text: Die Abfahrt des Zuges nach Hamburg verzögert sich um wenige Minuten auf Gleis vier.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker delivers the text at a very fast, rushed pace, matching the instruction to speak almost breathlessly.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speaking rate is very high, conveying a breathless and hurried quality.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech maintains natural pronunciation and flow despite the rapid pace.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The rushed delivery successfully creates a sense of urgency suitable for a fast announcement.

instruction: Speak in German. Say this slowly and clearly.
text: Könnten Sie mir bitte das Salz reichen?

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is spoken in German at an extremely slow pace with very clear articulation, perfectly fulfilling the instruction.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speech is delivered at a very slow, deliberate pace with clear pauses between words.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The extreme slowness results in a highly stilted and unnatural rhythm.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is flat and monotonous, lacking natural conversational expression.

instruction: Speak in German. Please read this sentence with a very slow and measured cadence.
text: Das Great Barrier Reef vor der Küste Australiens ist das größte Korallenriffsystem der Welt.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio strictly follows the instruction to speak at a very slow and measured cadence, but the extreme slowness results in an unnatural delivery.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speaker leaves distinct pauses between words and slightly stretches syllables, clearly achieving a very slow speech rate.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The word-by-word separation makes the speech sound disjointed and synthetically strained.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The disjointed pacing flattens the intonation, stripping the delivery of natural expressive variation.
